% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % (a) 2 -> 2
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl] (-0.8,0.7)--(0,0)--(0.8,0.7); \draw[fdl] (-0.8,-0.7)--(0,0)--(0.8,-0.7);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.8,0.7){$p_A$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.8,-0.7){$p_B$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,0.7){$p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,-0.7){$p_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.55) {(a) $2\to2$: $4!$ attachments\\[1pt] $i\mathcal M=-i\lambda$, allowed};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) 1 -> 3
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-0.9,0)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.8,0.7); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.9,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.8,-0.7);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.9,0){$p_A$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,0.7){$p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.9,0){$p_2$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,-0.7){$p_3$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.55) {(b) $1\to3$, $3\to1$\\[1pt] forbidden, $m<3m$};
  \end{scope}
  % (c) 0 -> 4
  \begin{scope}[xshift=9.0cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.8,0.75); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.95,0.25); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.95,-0.25); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.8,-0.75);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,0.75){$p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.95,0.25){$p_2$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.95,-0.25){$p_3$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.8,-0.75){$p_4$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.4,-1.55) {(c) $0\to4$, $4\to0$\\[1pt] forbidden};
  \end{scope}
  % (d) 1 -> 1 with loop
  \begin{scope}[xshift=0cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-0.9,0)--(0.9,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0.38) circle (0.38); \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.9,0){$p_A$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.9,0){$p_1$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.3) {(d) $1\to1$, one loop\\[1pt] $-\frac{i\lambda}{2}D_F(0)$: forward only,\\[1pt] a mass shift};
  \end{scope}
  % (e) 0 -> 2 with loop
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.6cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.85,0.5); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.85,-0.5); \draw[fdl] (-0.38,0) circle (0.38); \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (0.85,0.5){$p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (0.85,-0.5){$p_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.1,-1.3) {(e) $0\to2$, $2\to0$\\[1pt] one loop: forbidden};
  \end{scope}
  % (f) vacuum bubble
  \begin{scope}[xshift=9.4cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0.3) circle (0.3); \draw[fdl] (0,-0.3) circle (0.3); \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.3) {(f) $0\to0$, the vacuum bubble\\[1pt] $-\frac{i\lambda}{8}D_F(0)^2(2\pi)^4\delta^4(0)$:\\[1pt] a phase};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
